messages.content: Return only the contracted JSON. Adversarially review whether this proposal-development bid's semantic terms are sufficient to implement a lawful reusable SDSS accepted-delivery receiver, without deciding award or admission. Bid urn:sha256:9dc7eb0d63554f25c0cf33240c921d9fd5f0b13491143c4b8626f06990fb5f88 exactly snapshots lot urn:sha256:4a163a732d6057dece55f9ab1e0d4af52c28483e8bb18868179608fb22eec97f. It requires exactly separate operations: stage-accepted-software-delivery and review-and-admit-staged-software-delivery. Staging consumes exact locally recorded product, accepting decision and decision receipt IDs; verifies content/artifact/path/receiver/target/replay/expiry/create-only conditions; writes only service-owned SDSS staging; appends receipt with staged-tree digest. Admission consumes exact staging receipt/tree digest, service identity, contract, SDSS target root and distinct one-use expiring receiver grant; revalidates tree and mesh scope; creates only absent exact target; appends separate admission receipt. Product contract requires staging receipt bindings for product and artifact digests, decision/receipt, service/contract/root, staged tree, capability/expiry/time, and admission bindings for staging receipt/tree, service/contract/root, grant/time. Prohibited: ambientPath,globalRoster,overwrite,customerMutation,foreignMutation,network,spend,credentials,git,ttiMutation. Validation proves accepted alone creates nothing; staging needs exact accepted records and verifies every byte/path, capability one-use/expiry/replay, create-only, tree digest; staged alone creates no admission; admission needs distinct grant, revalidates tree/service/contract/target/mesh, create-only, receipt bindings; refusals leave target and receipts unchanged. Delivery is proposal-only and neither staging nor admission is authorized by the bid. Check specifically TOCTOU, symlink/path traversal, partial-write atomicity, receipt lookup authority, mesh revalidation, replay, and whether acceptance can be confused with admission.

blockingIssues: TOCTOU: path/target/replay/expiry/create-only checks are not required to be atomic with the subsequent write; a scheduling gap permits race-condition substitution of staging-area contents or path targets.

Symlink/traversal: ambientPath prohibition does not require canonical resolution before path comparison; a symlink at any component redirects a verified path to an unverified target without violating stated terms.
Partial-write atomicity: staging-area writes and both receipt-appends carry no atomicity requirement; a partial write leaves inconsistent state not covered by the refusal-leaves-unchanged invariant.

Receipt lookup authority: 'locally recorded' acceptance records have no integrity or authentication requirement; a substituted acceptance-decision or receipt ID can authorize staging of never-accepted content.
Mesh scope undefined: admission revalidation names 'tree and mesh scope' but defines no scope boundary; the obligation is vacuous and cannot be evaluated for conformance.
Staging replay mechanism unspecified: replay-verification for stage-accepted-software-delivery names no detection method (seen-digest registry, nonce consumption); the prohibition is unenforceable.

Receipt-type distinguishability unspecified: staging and admission receipts require no distinct type markers; admission could consume a prior admission receipt as a staging receipt, enabling repeat-admission.
